title: One writer core serves parity and requirement backlogs
statement: The parity writer's id, reference, ruling and freeze logic MUST serve any registered programme through a profile, with parity's behaviour unchanged.
why: In use the proven writer is id-stable and ruling-safe, and one core gives every programme the same locks, op ids and lost-update refusals.

acceptance.text: Given the existing parity corpora, when the writer's existing test suite runs after the change, then every test passes with no fixture changed.
Given the tracked parity backlog, when its report is rendered, then the page matches the one rendered before the change apart from its stamp.

falsifiedBy: A parity test fixture edited to make the change pass, or an existing id that moves when an atom is inserted ahead of it.

sources.quote: One `backlog.json` format across distiller, driver and build loop.
Any migration that reshapes EUDPA-328's backlog breaks tim CI
